BASELINE.description: Retain raw dated GSC requests/responses and query/intent matrix with exact locale/device/volume unknowns; obtain required controlled observations or explicit owner disposition. Partial returned windows are not finalized 28-day comparisons.

REQUIREMENTS.description: Fresh distinct nonauthor Requirements preflight before dependent implementation and final exact-candidate review of changed acceptance/oracles; preserve initial findings and correction dispositions.

DESTINATION.description: Author-approved existing SDLC primary delivery explanation; distinct companion canonicals and upstream Subprime authority; reconcile #8/#11/#116/#183 without duplicate hub.

EDITORIAL.description: Independent source/editorial review of new attribution, synthesis and exact source-to-HTML/PDF parity, preserving thought-experiment and evidence limits and accurate rights/edition dates.

REVIEW.description: Completed fresh distinct nonauthor Requirements, Code, White-box and Exploratory results on the actual changed template/oracle/PDF/preview scope, with source-bound execution and isolation receipts.

PUBLICATION.description: Author approves the concrete new edition and required publication treatment; preview preparation is not actual site/external publication. Historical editions/events are immutable.

SURFACES.description: Actual exact-candidate PR Preview at desktop/mobile and no-JavaScript for changed readers/Research links, PDF visual inspection and native link/reading checks; physical-device limits explicit.

SEARCH.description: Under #8 inspect live indexing, Google-selected and Medium canonical and actual production robots/sitemap/metadata when accessible. Missing observations remain pending.

STYLE-REVIEW.description: Independent applicable CS01/02/04/05/08/09/10 judgment beyond bounded guard; preserve unchanged CSS/runtime/resource budgets and review exact test/oracle scope.

TECHNICAL-SCOPE.description: Complete or explicitly obtain owner disposition for issue-wide technical SEO scope, including source-supported Article schema enrichment deferred from this first preview. Source tests cannot waive it.

RELEASE.description: Existing PR Preview → separately authorized Stable Staging → protected merge and separately authorized Production with exact source/artifact/served-byte evidence; current author instruction authorizes correction and Stable Staging only; protected merge and Production remain separate decisions.

MEASUREMENT.description: Retain baseline export; #213 owns equal finalized 28-day page/disclosed-query comparisons after delivery, with #8 URL Inspection handoff and separate controlled AI/entity observations. Record actual result, including no improvement.
